Support

Need help? Email david.jabech@gmail.com. I usually reply within one or two business days.

How do I restore my purchase?

Open Committed, open the Lifetime Unlock screen, and tap Restore purchase. Make sure you are signed in with the Apple ID used for the original purchase.

How does iCloud backup work?

Backup syncs your data to your private iCloud account. You can manage it in the app’s Settings. The developer cannot access the information in your iCloud account.

How do hidden commitments stay private?

Hidden commitments are protected by Face ID on your device. The app never receives your biometric data.

Does Committed collect my data?

No. Committed uses no analytics or tracking and collects no personal data. The Privacy Policy has the full details.
